name: Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Buenos Aires
notes: MACBA on Avenida San Juan in San Telmo (Vila Sebastian Arquitectos, opened 2012): a 15 m front between party walls, seven floors in exposed concrete, its face one great glazed plane (15 x 12 m) held in a concrete frame over a set-back glass entrance, a slot window above, lower at the back; the brick warehouse of the Museo de Arte Moderno next door to the west and lower houses to the east. From the museum's page, universes.art and Arquitectura de Calle; guessed: the depth (about 50 m), the rear height, the neighbours' heights and the frame's exact proportions. No photographs were available.
